% Primitive x-flux Jacobian A_W (7×7)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A_W_matrix}
\left[\begin{matrix}v_{x} & \rho & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\\0 & v_{x} & 0 & 0 & \frac{B_{y}}{\rho} & \frac{B_{z}}{\rho} & \frac{1}{\rho}\\0 & 0 & v_{x} & 0 & - \frac{B_{x}}{\rho} & 0 & 0\\0 & 0 & 0 & v_{x} & 0 & - \frac{B_{x}}{\rho} & 0\\0 & B_{y} & - B_{x} & 0 & v_{x} & 0 & 0\\0 & B_{z} & 0 & - B_{x} & 0 & v_{x} & 0\\0 & \gamma p & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & v_{x}\end{matrix}\right]
\end{equation}

% Characteristic speed definitions
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_speed_defs}
c_{s_0}^{2} = \gamma p/\rho,\quad c_{Ax}^{2} = B_x^{2}/\rho,\quad c_{A\perp}^{2} = (B_y^{2}+B_z^{2})/\rho,\quad c_{A}^{2} = c_{Ax}^{2} + c_{A\perp}^{2}
\end{equation}

% Fast / slow magnetosonic roots
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_cfs}
c_{f,s}^{2} = \tfrac{1}{2}\!\left[(c_{s_0}^{2} + c_{A}^{2}) \pm \sqrt{(c_{s_0}^{2}+c_{A}^{2})^{2} - 4 c_{s_0}^{2} c_{Ax}^{2}}\right]
\end{equation}

% Discriminant identities (HLLD-stable forms)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_discriminant}
c_f^{2} + c_s^{2} = c_{s_0}^{2} + c_{A}^{2},\qquad c_f^{2}\,c_s^{2} = c_{s_0}^{2}\,c_{Ax}^{2}
\end{equation}

% Seven wave speeds
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_wave_speeds_final}
\{\lambda_k\}_{k=1}^{7} = \{v_x - c_f,\ v_x - c_{Ax},\ v_x - c_s,\ v_x,\ v_x + c_s,\ v_x + c_{Ax},\ v_x + c_f\}
\end{equation}

% Numerical Roe-check result
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_numerical_check}
\max_{\text{60 trials}}\left\{|\lambda_{\text{closed}} - \lambda_{\text{numerical}}|\right\} < 10^{-9}
\end{equation}

% Eigenvector normalisation parameters α, β
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_alpha_beta}
\alpha_f^{2} = \frac{c_{s_0}^{2} - c_s^{2}}{c_f^{2} - c_s^{2}},\ \alpha_s^{2} = \frac{c_f^{2} - c_{s_0}^{2}}{c_f^{2} - c_s^{2}};\quad \beta_y = \frac{B_y}{\sqrt{B_y^{2}+B_z^{2}}},\ \beta_z = \frac{B_z}{\sqrt{B_y^{2}+B_z^{2}}}
\end{equation}

% Entropy (contact) right-eigenvector
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_r_entropy}
\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{entropy}} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}
\end{equation}

% Alfvén right-eigenvector (parametric)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_r_Alfven}
\mathbf{r}_{A\pm} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 0 \\ \mp s\beta_z \\ \pm s\beta_y \\ -\beta_z\sqrt{\rho} \\ \beta_y\sqrt{\rho} \\ 0 \end{bmatrix},\quad s = \mathrm{sign}(B_x)
\end{equation}

% Fast right-eigenvector (parametric)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_r_fast}
\mathbf{r}_{f\pm} = \begin{bmatrix} \rho\alpha_f \\ \pm\alpha_f c_f \\ \mp s\alpha_s c_s\beta_y \\ \mp s\alpha_s c_s\beta_z \\ \alpha_s c_{s_0}\sqrt{\rho}\,\beta_y \\ \alpha_s c_{s_0}\sqrt{\rho}\,\beta_z \\ \alpha_f\gamma p \end{bmatrix}
\end{equation}

% Slow right-eigenvector (parametric)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3_r_slow}
\mathbf{r}_{s\pm} = \begin{bmatrix} \rho\alpha_s \\ \pm\alpha_s c_s \\ \pm s\alpha_f c_f\beta_y \\ \pm s\alpha_f c_f\beta_z \\ -\alpha_f c_{s_0}\sqrt{\rho}\,\beta_y \\ -\alpha_f c_{s_0}\sqrt{\rho}\,\beta_z \\ \alpha_s\gamma p \end{bmatrix}
\end{equation}
